title: Lead content of drinking water pipe and fittings.
officialText:
Pipe, pipe fittings, joints, valves, faucets, and fixture fittings utilized to
supply water for drinking or cooking purposes shall comply with NSF 372 and shall have a weighted average lead content of 0.25
percent or less.
